target_vertical: Multi-channel retailer (Shopify POS Pro merchants — retail / DTC brands with physical store)
pricing_model: Bundled — included with Shopify POS Pro subscription, no separate per-user/per-order fee. Requires Shopify POS Pro at USD $89/month per location (USD $79/month with annual billing).
starting_price_usd: 0 (included with Shopify POS Pro at $89/mo per location)
free_trial_or_freemium: Free for all merchants on the Shopify POS Pro plan. No standalone trial — accessed via Shopify POS Pro subscription (Shopify POS Pro has trials tied to the overall Shopify plan).
shopify_app_listing_url: https://apps.shopify.com/stocky (delisted from the Shopify App Store on 2026-02-02; cannot be reinstalled; full sunset 2026-08-31)
shopify_install_count: Approximately 160–250 public reviews on the Shopify App Store (sources cite 161 and 247 at different dates) [uncertain]
shopify_built_for_shopify_badge: No — Stocky is a first-party Shopify app and does not carry the Built for Shopify third-party badge
shopify_plus_partner_status: No (not applicable — first-party Shopify app, not a Plus Certified App Partner)
shopify_sync_direction: Bi-directional with Shopify admin for inventory levels and product/variant data; purchase orders, suppliers, stocktakes, transfers and cost data are authored in Stocky and push inventory/cost changes back to Shopify when committed.
shopify_synced_entities: Products, variants, inventory levels (multi-location), product cost, vendors. Reads orders/sales history for forecasting and ABC analysis. Purchase orders, stocktakes, stock transfers and suppliers are managed inside Stocky and synced back as inventory adjustments / cost updates in Shopify. Does not sync customers, fulfillments, refunds or draft orders as distinct entities.
shopify_service_item_support: No dedicated service-item handling — Stocky is purely physical inventory / POS-oriented
shopify_multi_store_support: No — Stocky is scoped to a single Shopify store / POS Pro instance per install [uncertain]
shopify_pos_support: Deep — Stocky requires Shopify POS Pro and is the native inventory companion to Shopify POS Pro (barcode receiving, stocktakes and transfers usable through the POS workflow with an HID/USB scanner)
shopify_b2b_catalog_support: No native Shopify B2B catalogs / company-location / price-list awareness
shopify_markets_support: No — Stocky has no specific Shopify Markets (multi-market pricing / duties / landed cost) functionality
shopify_metafield_to_erp_field_mapping: No — no generic metafield ↔ custom-field mapping engine
shopify_variant_option_mapping: Uses Shopify's native product/variant/SKU model directly; variants in Shopify are mirrored 1:1 in Stocky without custom mapping
shopify_real_time_or_batch: Near real-time inventory updates via the Shopify API when actions are committed in Stocky (e.g. receiving a PO, completing a stocktake); some background syncs run on a polled / batched cadence [uncertain]
shopify_known_limitations: Sunset announced — Stocky was delisted on 2026-02-02 and is shutting down on 2026-08-31; inventory transfers and min/max forecasting features were already removed in July 2025. Only available on Shopify POS Pro. Historical Stocky data (purchase orders, stocktakes) does not auto-migrate into Shopify after sunset and must be manually exported. Frequently reported issues: lack of true mobile app, scanner mode-switching pain (POS needs iOS mode, Stocky needs HID/keyboard mode), bugs, server downtime, label-printing issues, poor support. No multi-channel inventory sync (Amazon/eBay/Etsy not supported), no bundle/kit tracking, no manufacturing/BOM, no deep accounting integration. Stocky's own API is largely read-only.
etsy_known_limitations: Stocky has no Etsy channel support — Etsy sales would have to be managed outside Stocky
amazon_known_limitations: Stocky offers zero Amazon integration — a primary reason brands migrate off Stocky to multi-channel tools (Prediko, Inventory Planner, Cogsy, Qoblex etc.) when they add Amazon FBA
xero_supported: Third-party (via the Xero Bridge by Parex Shopify app, which can sync Stocky purchase orders to Xero). No direct/native Xero integration from Stocky itself.
xero_app_store_certified: Not applicable (Stocky has no direct Xero App Store listing)
xero_synced_entities: Via third-party bridge only: purchase orders can flow to Xero as bills. No direct COGS journal, invoice, payment, credit note or inventory adjustment sync from Stocky to Xero.
xero_accounting_sync_mode: Not applicable from Stocky directly; depends on the third-party bridge (typically invoice/bill-per-document)
xero_cogs_journal_method: None — Stocky does not post COGS journals to Xero
xero_known_limitations: No direct Xero integration; merchants rely on third-party connectors (e.g. Xero Bridge by Parex, A2X, Synder) layered on top of Shopify rather than Stocky
qb_online_supported: Third-party (no native QBO integration from Stocky; merchants use Shopify-level QBO connectors such as A2X or Synder)
qb_desktop_supported: Yes — Stocky can integrate with QuickBooks Desktop via the QuickBooks Desktop Connector app for Shopify (requires entering the Stocky API key to enable sync)
qb_app_certified: Not applicable (Stocky itself is not listed on the Intuit App Store)
qb_synced_entities: QuickBooks Desktop via connector: purchase orders / inventory cost data from Stocky. No direct QBO sync of invoices, payments, COGS journals or credit memos from Stocky.
qb_accounting_sync_mode: Document-level via QuickBooks Desktop Connector for POs; QBO sync handled by separate Shopify-level apps, not Stocky [uncertain]
qb_cogs_journal_method: None — Stocky does not post COGS journals to QuickBooks
qb_known_limitations: No native QuickBooks Online integration; only QuickBooks Desktop via the dedicated connector, and the sync scope is narrow (mainly PO / inventory cost data)
other_ecom_channels: None — Stocky only operates on Shopify (including Shopify POS Pro). It does not integrate with WooCommerce, BigCommerce, eBay, Walmart, TikTok Shop, Wix, Squarespace, Faire, Square, Magento, or custom storefronts.
bundle_kit_component_decomposition: No — Stocky does not natively decompose bundle/kit sales into components
other_accounting_integrations: None directly. Stocky has no native integration with Sage 50/Intacct, Zoho Books, MYOB, FreshBooks, NetSuite, or Wave. Any accounting flow is handled at the Shopify level by separate apps.
bom_support: No — Stocky has no bill of materials functionality
production_orders: No work orders / manufacturing orders / routings
batch_lot_tracking: No lot or batch tracking with expiry
bin_location_support: No bin / aisle / sub-location tracking inside a warehouse
multi_warehouse: Yes — supports multiple Shopify locations and lets you create stock transfers between them (note: transfers feature was removed in July 2025 ahead of sunset)
barcoding: Yes — Stocky supports barcode scanning for receiving POs and stocktakes via a USB / HID keyboard-mode barcode scanner; can generate barcode labels for products [uncertain on label printing depth]
purchase_orders: Yes — full PO creation (per-vendor or multi-vendor via supplier groups), partial receipts, email POs to suppliers, cost price tracking, supplier cost price lists
supplier_management: Yes — supplier and vendor records, supplier groups (multi-vendor POs), supplier cost price lists, stock-on-hand-by-vendor reporting. Lead times and MOQs are supported at a basic level [uncertain on MOQ depth].
landed_cost_support: Limited — landed cost can be added to a PO and allocated to inventory cost when receiving [uncertain on freight/duty/insurance breakdown]
multi_currency_inventory_valuation: Limited — cost is held in the Shopify store's base currency; supplier PO documents can be in foreign currencies but valuation is single base [uncertain]
ai_demand_forecasting: No AI/ML — Stocky uses statistical demand forecasting based on past sales history (forecast horizon in days, by location, with Fill-Shelves / Target-Stock-Level methods). The min/max forecasting feature was removed in July 2025.
ai_purchase_order_suggestions: Suggested POs based on the rules-based forecast (not AI/ML) — generates draft POs from forecasted demand and stock-on-hand
public_api: Limited — Stocky exposes a primarily read-only REST API (e.g. fetch purchase orders) requiring a Store-Name header and Stocky API key; cannot create or update most resources via the API
webhook_event_coverage: No public outbound webhook framework documented [uncertain]
integration_architecture: Native first-party Shopify app for the Shopify side; third-party / partner-built bridges for everything else (accounting, multi-channel)
zapier_make_support: No official Zapier / Make / n8n connector for Stocky [uncertain]
mobile_app: No dedicated Stocky mobile app — Stocky is web-based, accessed from a browser or via the Shopify Apps section. Shopify POS app on iOS/Android can be used alongside it.
mobile_barcode_scanning_app: No native mobile scanner — Stocky relies on an external USB/HID barcode scanner in keyboard mode; a frequent complaint is the lack of a true mobile scanning app
rate_limit_handling_documented: Not publicly documented for Stocky's own API [uncertain]
sync_frequency: Near real-time for inventory level changes when actions are committed in Stocky against the Shopify Admin API; some forecasting / reporting data refreshes on a slower (likely hourly/daily) cadence [uncertain]
shipping_carrier_integrations: None directly in Stocky — shipping/carrier integrations are handled at the Shopify / Shopify Shipping layer, not in Stocky
shipping_label_buying: No — Stocky does not buy or print carrier shipping labels (handled by Shopify Shipping)
three_pl_integrations: None — Stocky has no native 3PL integrations (ShipBob, ShipHero, Extensiv, Deliverr, FBA, etc.)
notable_customers: Public Shopify POS Pro retail merchants — Stocky is bundled with POS Pro so install base spans many Shopify Plus and DTC retailers, but Shopify does not publish named Stocky case studies [uncertain]
last_major_release: End-of-life announcement: delisted from Shopify App Store on 2026-02-02; min/max forecasting and inventory transfers removed July 2025; full sunset 2026-08-31. Shopify is migrating functionality into native Shopify Admin inventory management.
owner_parent_company: Shopify Inc. (Stocky was acquired by Shopify in 2020 from Stocky Apps Ltd.)
last_funding_event: Acquired by Shopify in 2020 [uncertain on exact month/terms]
public_status_page_uptime: No dedicated Stocky status page — covered by the general Shopify status page (https://www.shopifystatus.com) [uncertain]
